pages.title: Angel Ring
pages.text: The Angel Ring item in this mod’s creative tab opens a clickable chat link. Flight is provided by DenisMasterHerobrine’s separate Angel Ring mod when installed. Use that mod’s ring for its flight mechanics.

pages.title: Flying Squid Ring
pages.text: This legacy ring is available in Creative. It has no bundled recipe or flight mechanic in this port. For movement or fall protection, use the Chicken Wing Rings.
